title: T20I Batting Greatness — era, team carry and career/peak
sourceScope: Existing historical batting research snapshot plus Cricsheet international scorecards, scoped to t20i.
historicalSourceRights: Historical innings originate in ESPN-derived 2017 snapshot; independent redistribution permission NOT verified.
publicationPolicy: Only aggregate player-level analytic scores and grouped nation/venue metrics. No historical source match/innings records.

rules.quality: 72% log era/match/opposition/venue-adjusted run production + 28% log dismissal survival; n/(n+35) shrinkage
rules.teamCarry: Within each innings, run production vs mean teammate runs; equal innings, 20-innings reliability shrinkage
rules.careerGreatness: Quality premium with sample size + cumulative contextual runs above expected; researcher-defined, not trained
rules.peak: Best rolling 25-innings same-format scorecard quality, no sample-size shrinkage; selection bias acknowledged
rules.opposition: Other batters' runs per appearance vs opponent in ±5 years, excluding rated batter's entire career and evaluated match; shrunken proxy, not individual bowler strength
rules.homeAway: Observed home/away scoring factor by nearby-year peers; unknown venues unadjusted
rules.conditions: Other batters' scoring within the same Test excluding the evaluated batter's all innings; proxy, not measured pitch
rules.uncertainty: 90% conditional match-cluster bootstrap, fixed fitted baselines; excludes source missingness and historical structural uncertainty
rules.battingPosition: NOT controlled: unavailable systematically in historical dataset
rules.seriesContext: NOT modeled: no consistent historical series identifier
rules.individualBowlers: NOT controlled in common all-era model: modern-only evidence
rules.jawsStyle: Average of career standardized surplus and seven best observed seasonal surplus values; all years use same units; NOT WAR; opportunity bias remains
rules.matchOutcome: NOT a core feature; historical match outcomes missing from the source

limitations: Historical data rights are unverified; confirm use of aggregate model outputs before public commercialization.
Modern match IDs and older date/team signatures are only provisionally reconciled.
No cross-era bowler-by-bowler exposure, consistent batting position or measured pitch.
Opponent quality and same-match difficulty are correlational, imperfect scoring proxies.
The index has not been externally calibrated against outcomes or source-complete scorecards.
Match-block bootstrap does not incorporate model, selection or historical source uncertainty.
Team carry is relative to recorded teammates and can reward playing on a weaker team.
A top rank does not imply a hypothetical head-to-head win between eras.
